overall_goal: Clean up the workspace and store leftover ingredients

goals.rationale: The person picks up the cut lemon, washes it under the tap, shakes off the excess water, and places it back on the chopping board.

goals.description: Clean up spilled food and throw it away
goals.rationale: The person picks up bits of food from the countertop and the floor and disposes of them in the rubbish bin.

goals.description: Store the lemon in a plastic container in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a plastic container from the cabinet, places the lemon inside, seals it, and stores it in the refrigerator.

goals.description: Wipe hands and tidy the kitchen rag
goals.rationale: The person grabs the kitchen rag, uses it to wipe their hands, and then folds it neatly on the countertop.
